title: How Vestiaire Collective achieved near-zero downtime RDS for MariaDB upgrades with Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments
text: Vestiaire Collective, a global platform for pre-owned luxury fashion, achieved near-zero downtime upgrading its Amazon RDS for MariaDB fleet across two major versions. Learn how the team used Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments with AWS Countdown Premium to deliver a 94-second and then a 7-second switchover during peak sales season.
